example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখ মধু, সবাইকে আকর্ষণ করে।
সে মুখ মধু করে সবাইকে খুশি রাখে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a honeyed tongue that attracts everyone.
She uses sweet talk to keep everyone happy.
note: Refers to someone who speaks in a pleasing, flattering manner, often to gain favor.
